_comment: Evaluation design for redesigned platform strategies. Parameters were fixed from conventional defaults before any data was examined; development data (through developmentEnd) was used only to confirm the mechanics work. Results after developmentEnd are the holdout (out of sample). Part of each strategy version's identity.

tmpl_spy_trend_filter.objective: Participate in uptrends and avoid prolonged downtrends.
tmpl_spy_trend_filter.benchmark: Buy & hold of the same symbol; judged on drawdown and time in market as well as return.
tmpl_spy_trend_filter.parameterBasis: 200-day moving-average regime from Alpha Engine with 2 confirming sessions — a conventional trend definition, not fitted.

tmpl_momentum_sell.objective: Hold only while short-term momentum lasts; exit on reversal or loss.
tmpl_momentum_sell.benchmark: Buy & hold of the same symbol; judged on return per time in market and drawdown.
tmpl_momentum_sell.parameterBasis: 20-session (about one month) momentum of 5%, 10-session reversal of 5%, and an 8% stop below cost — conventional values, not fitted.

tmpl_dca_accumulator.objective: Spread entry over time instead of investing at once.
tmpl_dca_accumulator.benchmark: Lump-sum buy & hold of the same capital on day one; judged on drawdown and return.
tmpl_dca_accumulator.parameterBasis: Monthly installments of 10% of capital — a common DCA schedule, not fitted.

tmpl_loss_guard.benchmark: Buy & hold of the same symbol; judged mainly on maximum drawdown.
tmpl_loss_guard.parameterBasis: Monthly entries and a 10% stop below average cost — conventional values, not fitted.
